design: 12 paired linear five-node observed DAG worlds with one latent Gaussian common parent of exactly two observed nodes; latent variable absent from the 29,281-DAG inference space. Corrected nested width1 vs width2, budget 8.
interpretation: The supported correctly specified width-2 breadth controller is not robust to a simple unmodeled latent common cause. Width-2 failed to beat width-1 on every screened pair and worsened mean edge recovery. Do not power this mechanism without adding latent-confounder-aware inference or a different robust objective.
